verdict.rationale: Codegen lacks a documented diff-review-then-approve gate, but you can approximate one. You can turn off the agent's ability to open PRs (codegen-docs-32, codegen-docs-24). The CLI then lets you pull agent branches and code changes locally to inspect (codegen-docs-13). Agents can also present a structured plan before implementing (codegen-docs-22), and paused runs can be resumed (codegen-docs-35). Missing for 10: a built-in diff review UI for agent changes, an explicit approve-before-PR workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
